subject: Future Tech
title: Topology Optimization
description: A micro-lesson that makes Topology Optimization usable.

hook.text: Topology optimization uses algorithms to design parts that are as strong as possible while using the least material.

buildup.text: The software starts with a solid block and removes material from areas with low stress, leaving organic flowing shapes.

discovery.text: Airbus used topology optimization to redesign a cabin partition. The new design is 45% lighter while equally strong.

twist.text: These optimized shapes are impossible to make with traditional machining.

climax.text: AI-driven generative design now proposes hundreds of optimized options.

punchline.text: Let the algorithm design it. Let the printer build it.

quiz.question: How much lighter was Airbus's topology-optimized cabin partition?
